run_ab_test: run an A/B test on the Habitat-Sim simulator comparing a feature's control and test values across resolutions
run_ab_test_with_physics: run an A/B test on the simulator with physics enabled and multiple spawned objects
run_ab_test_csv_output: run an A/B test on the simulator and write performance results to a CSV file
refactor_get_percent_diff_str: refactor the get_percent_diff_str function to handle division by zero when control value is zero
summarize_print_metric: summarize the print_metric function that prints a formatted performance comparison table by resolution and process count
